name: Antepia Restaurant und Hotel
beschreibung: The Antepia Restaurant und Hotel is situated in Kufstein, Tyrol. Located in the city centre close to the historic old town, it blends welcoming accommodation with a distinct culinary establishment. The restaurant specialises in oriental and Mediterranean cuisine. Guest rooms are modernly furnished, each featuring an en-suite bathroom and satellite television. Visitors can dine and stay conveniently under one roof. Its central location provides an ideal starting point for exploring the town of Kufstein and the surrounding Tyrolean region.
